blockingIssues.description: DashboardService calls YearMonth.of(year, month) without request validation, so invalid month values can throw DateTimeException and return HTTP 500 instead of a clear 400 response.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require workers to report TDD-order deviations in handoff.skillFeedback whenever tests are not written first, and add a scrutiny check to flag mismatches between transcript sequence and 'followedProcedure=true'.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both budget-backend-api and budget-dashboard-frontend-ui review reports observed implementation code created before tests while skill feedback still claimed full procedure adherence.

rejectedObservations.observation: Frontend review shared-state note about TDD/procedure mismatch
